audits.text:
## 7aed1f233b46

**Reproduced under-identification: “largest non-full-canvas bbox” survives every
generated example sampled.** The intended rule selects the unique color whose
row-then-column closure fills its bounding rectangle. A plausible rival discards
any candidate whose bounding box is the entire input canvas, then outputs the
largest remaining bounding box as a cyan rectangle. It fits both public training
pairs and all **8,000/8,000** generated draws checked (seeds 0–99, indices 0–19,
four bands), so it also fits all **8,000/8,000** cyclic five-demo lessons. The
sample contained 7,638 distinct inputs and 1,600 examples from each of the five
scheduled profiles. Evidence: `checks/audit/7aed1f233b46/probe.json` and
`receipt.json`.

The schedule's `larger_decoy` and `position_decoy` profiles use a conspicuous
decoy whose bounding box is exactly the full canvas. In every other profile the
winner is the largest non-full-canvas candidate. The existing source-bound probe
correctly refutes its five *declared* rivals, but this additional rival is absent;
its clean 60-draw receipt is retained at
`checks/audit/7aed1f233b46/declared-shortcut-probe.log`.

A strict-canonical-like 8x12 counterexample contains a true 3x3 four-corner
winner, a larger non-full-canvas 4x5 three-corner decoy, and a 2x3 decoy.
`self_check` and `strict_canonical_like` both return no errors. Canonical Racket
outputs 3x3 cyan, while the rival outputs 4x5 cyan:
`checks/audit/7aed1f233b46/input.json`, `racket.json`, and
`rival_output.json`. The receipt binds generator SHA-256
`8611cbb884c2babafac47be4e66e6ed1d96f42fee51c2da02143b41e4723d3ea`
and rule hash `20b242594e4b`.

The target's supported portable task-test stage still passes **27/27** tests
(`checks/audit/7aed1f233b46/task-tests-run/`). A future repair should make at
least one scheduled larger decoy non-full-canvas, add this rival to the semantic
contract, and verify all cyclic lesson starts. No audit-target source was
modified.

triage.reason: Retained both adversarial findings and reproducers in their target indexes; unrelated target source remains unchanged.
